g.title: policy
g.text: Called after duplicate lookup, while lock is held.

g.title: repository
g.text: Provide one PostgreSQL connection at READ COMMITTED.

g.title: transaction
g.text: All calls share one connection and transaction.
Early exit closes it; pre-commit failure rolls back.

g.title: service->transaction
g.text: calls lock / find / count / insert / commit
Read-only exits release lock without writes.

g.title: mail
g.text: Python call; HTTPS adapter to University Mail.
Timeout/error becomes Unavailable; no automatic retry.

g.title: service->mail
g.text: calls only for a new seat

g.title: types
g.text: title: str, start_time: datetime, capacity: int, published: bool
student_id: StudentId, name: str, email: Email, created_at: datetime
StudentId = opaque provider string; Email = verified profile string.

g.title: invariant
g.text: 0 ≤ stored reservations per workshop ≤ capacity; at most one per student.
Every insert first locks the SAME workshop row with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE.
Keep that lock through duplicate lookup, count, insert and commit.
Use READ COMMITTED with fresh reads AFTER acquiring the lock.
A waiting request then sees the first request's committed seat.
Capacity is fixed at creation; no edit/cancel/unpublish operation in this scope.
An existing reservation wins over the full check and never triggers mail.
Mail is outside the transaction, so its failure cannot remove a seat.
LEGEND: solid arrow = call/data flow; dashed arrow = type dependency.
Blue boundary = selected component; grey = supporting components.
